name: Add a label element
title: Add a line to this channel's label
help_text: Elements print top to bottom in position order. Takealot: Title (1), Barcode (2), Stacked text "MP" (3). Amazon FBA: Barcode (1), Title (2), Text "New" (3) — Amazon requires the item condition at the bottom of every unit label. Text is only used by Text and Stacked text; max lines only by Title; max bar height only by Barcode. Leave font size empty to let the layout size the text from the label height, which follows the label to a different roll — set it only to overrule that. Padding is blank space below the element. Every millimetre any of these takes comes out of the barcode, and the print page warns if the bars end up under 6.35 mm.
